claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves AW IMR 14500 600mAh 4A as a 600mAh preset with a 4A runtime rating.
The AW IMR 14500 600mAh sample tested in 2012 was listed as a red button-top wrapper and measured 14.07 mm diameter by 49.25 mm height, with the source's stated tolerance.

The AW IMR 14500 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
No reliable exact-model market-introduction date was established for AW IMR 14500 in the 2026-08-04 catalog-wide research pass.

authenticity.summary: The exact wrapper is described as red in the historical test, but no manufacturer verification path or batch-specific authenticity evidence was identified. A retailer authenticity guarantee is not independent authentication.
checks: Prefer an established specialist retailer and inspect the exact wrapper and markings.
Do not treat the red wrapper alone as proof of an authentic AW cell.
